gaps.quote: The resampling itself uses linear contractions
gaps.note: A contraction in this sense is not defined, so the reader cannot tell what the maps A and B_0 do to their inputs.

gaps.quote: The Gaussian window makes the error small when $t/s - 1$ is large compared with the precision parameter
gaps.note: The precision parameter is not defined on the page, and the claimed dependence of the error on t/s - 1 is not explained, so the reader cannot check it.
